pass_condition: signal is present in the predefined central state window and not dominated by endpoint behavior
fail_condition: signal appears only near cutoff, endpoint, or boundary-sensitive region
allowed_claim: Central-window diagnostic signal is supported under the tested protocol.
forbidden_claim: Do not use endpoint-only signal as primary plating fingerprint.

allowed_claim: The feature is not dominated by endpoint amplification in the tested window.

pass_condition: protocol_sensitivity_status is acceptable or explicitly bounded
fail_condition: protocol_sensitivity_status is sensitive and not bounded
allowed_claim: The diagnostic signal is supported within the tested protocol boundary.
forbidden_claim: Do not generalize to other protocols, chemistries, temperatures, or operating envelopes.

forbidden_claim: Do not claim fitting-target qualification in this contract notebook.
